notes.title: Announcement: Epic Auto Towers, auto battler & deckbuilding mix.
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

I'm excited to announce that I'm making a new game, "Epic Auto Towers"!

Epic Auto Towers is a turn-based strategy game combining elements of autobattler, deckbuilder and roguelike. Purchase uncommon and rare Towers and build the strongest combo to withstand the monster assault! Discover unusual new Tower combinations as you come back for more.

Add game to wishlist now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2116060/Epic_Auto_Towers/

notes.title: Egyptians special changed
notes.notes:
Now the Egyptians receive +4 faiths per year for each unit of food and begin without an additional 100 points of faith. They can still buy buildings for faith points, but the purchase price is higher. As before, the Egyptians don't do scouting.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26047560/7086248e731406145c0398ecb08252e0602a9b37.png[/img]

[h1]Why is this done?[/h1]
No scouting is a penalty. And the possibility of buying buildings for faith is not enough compensation for it. +4 faith for each unit of food is a good bonus that can compensate the lack of scouting.

[h1]Buying buildings for faith point[/h1]
The cost of buying buildings for points of faith has increased. This is due to the fact that the previous purchase of buildings was too complicated in terms of calculations and strategy. Now the main bonus of the Egyptians is faith for food. A purchase of buildings for the faith can now be both used and not used.

notes.title: New special games: Pioneers and Daily Special
notes.notes:
[h1]Daily Special[/h1]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26047560/b5bd914502b36a125e09969fee02f4c8f357ab2c.png[/img]
Daily Special Battle is a special game with some random conditions. That conditions change every day. 

You can play "Daily Special" more than once per day, but only one win per day will count towards completed daily battles score.

At the moment Daily Special can have such conditions:
[list]
    [*]Only some nations are available
    [*]Only some religions are available
    [*]One of the buildings not available (this rarely occurs)
[/list] 

[h1]Pioneers[/h1]
In this special game you can hire any unit for free!
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26047560/284a66b3564ae41faf4fe90c48ea00929e9d4cbf.png[/img]

But each building you have increases the cost of all buildings. 
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26047560/3a84439442988561823b644224df44a5f0064bcf.png[/img]

So you will have to choose carefully what building to buy.

notes.title: Dungeons editor (for battle editor)
notes.notes:
Dungeons editor has been added to battle editor!

You can now turn on custom dungeons in battle editor. 

It's also possible to use standard years instead of custom ones. This can be used to create a battle with new dungeons only. (If you use standard years, player will choose difficulty before playing your battle like in normal 50 years game.)
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26047560/6908e142c537eb81a9c67ad34116308e3c46dd17.png[/img]

You can read more about custom dungeons here:
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=931636298

notes.title: Battle Editor (Steam Workshop)
notes.notes:
Battle editor has been added to the game!

[h1]Battles[/h1]
Battles are like standart "50 years" game, where attackers are chosen by player who made the battle.

A battle is created in a batlle editor and then uploaded to Steam Workshop. Other players can subscribe to it.
[url=http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26047560/2810286949cfd5950e2fee6aa21a2a91a36c0690.png][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26047560/b7d75522a6ddf9392b22643272e3e555f3e8390e.png[/img][/url]


[h1]Battle editor[/h1]
To create a battle you need to specify how many units will attack each year. Then you must complete your own battle. After that the battle can be uploaded to Steam Workshop.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26047560/79eb8013196c6cda1466cab4ec69a480a11f7fe8.png[/img]
You can load image for a battle. This image will appear in workshop later.


[h1]Future plans[/h1]
We are planning to add creature dens editor to future versions of battle editor. You would be able to add your own dens instead of standart dens (Zombie chickens graveyard, Foggy Swamp, etc.)

notes.title: New lumber mills mechanics (+ the British improvements)
notes.notes:
Wood mechanics has been changed slightly.

As you know, lumber mills reduce the amount of gold mined by peasants.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26047560/3c4273061473acbae6c4747a389cef69d01574b8.png[/img]

That reducing is now capped at 75 gold per peasant:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26047560/312efefa2e964f05b3d9c84be877ab6ec4dff34f.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26047560/4fb55f09b6804051399607be93a5e9295895a803.png[/img]

The cost of lumber mills is also changed, so you can build 5+ lumber mills and start to gain a lot of wood. If you used to build only one lumber mill the game won't change much. And you can still play without wood to get maximum gold output.

-----

The British special has been improved. They still get +10 wood and +10 faith from forester's huts, but also theirs lumber mills gold penalty is capped at 50 gold per peasant.
